info.title: Personal OS API
info.description: Local-first personal platform. Phase 10a: finance intelligence (net worth, upcoming bills, merchant aliases, budget rollover, import profiles) + planner depth (subtasks, dependencies, day-load estimates, event exceptions, habit pause, weekly review).

url.description: normalized canonical URL (lowercase host, tracking params stripped)

source_item_id.description: native record id when mirrored from a pillar table

measured_at.description: one row per calendar day; same-day POST replaces
